rule: Only items that were tested and look promising. Shipped winners are listed under shipped. Each prompt must beat v2 on the 87-relation held-out set or its stated metric, or the PR is dropped.

shipped.result: tokens/query top-5 333->149; recall at v2 budget 15->21/87

items.title: Use the v3 packer in the live context-ranker prompt path, with a real tokenizer check
items.why: pack.mjs cut approximate tokens 55% and raised recall at the v2 budget from 15 to 21/87 (inner split: 10 to 12/56). The token counter was a regex, and no answer quality was measured.
items.cursor_prompt: In vitalitychems-dot/TESSERA, wire artifacts/v3/src/pack.mjs (packV3 with idf, sink:16) into wherever the context ranker's top-k results are turned into LLM prompt text. Keep the v2 JSON format behind a parameter for comparison. Add a benchmark that counts tokens with a real BPE tokenizer (an MIT/Apache JS tokenizer, offline, CPU) on the 87 outer held-out relations (same split as artifacts/v2/src/brain/bench4.mjs) and reports tokens/query and recall at an equal budget for v2 vs v3. Keep the change only if v3 has fewer tokens at equal or better recall. Do not flip TESSERA_ENABLE_* flags or edit workflows. Author: vitalitychems-dot noreply.

items.title: Answer-quality check: does sink-16 truncation lose facts the LLM needs?
items.why: sink16 cuts each item after 16 words. Recall of the target name is fine, but the facts in the observations may be lost.
items.cursor_prompt: In TESSERA artifacts/v3, add an offline, CPU-only eval. For each of the 87 held-out relations, check whether the packed context still contains the observation tokens that justify the relation (overlap between the relation's endpoint observations and the packed text). Compare sink:0 with sink:16 and sink:32. Keep the smallest sink whose fact-coverage is within 2 percentage points of sink:0. Report the numbers in the PR.

items.title: Faster warm crystal snapshots
items.why: Crystal cold snapshot dropped from 1748 to 6.2 ms, but warm is 5.8 ms vs v2 cached 0.7 ms.
items.cursor_prompt: In TESSERA artifacts/v3/src/crystal.mjs, add incremental checkpoints, for example a graphAt snapshot every 256 events with replay from the nearest checkpoint, so that warm /brain/snapshot?src=crystal p95 is at or below the v2 cached replayAt p95 on docs/v2/v2-memory.jsonl. Keep cold-load under 20 ms on the 3014-line full-picture file. Add a test like v2-079 W3-04. Keep it only if both targets pass.
